sanskrit_verse:
अर्थिना संनियुक्तो वा प्रत्यर्थिप्रहितोऽपि वा ।
यो यस्यार्थे विवदते तयोर् जयपराजयौ ॥
transliteration: arthinā saṃniyukto vā pratyarthiprahito 'pi vā | yo yasyārthe vivadate tayor jayaparājayau ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Whether appointed by the seeker or sent by the respondent, whoever engages in dispute for the sake of another, the outcome of victory or defeat belongs to the one on whose behalf the engagement occurs.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through conscious designation, not personal assertion.
Causation aligns with intent and service to dharma, not individual desire.
Capacity-based responsibility arises from alignment with the cause, not mere participation.
Restoration logic requires resolution that serves the true stakeholder's integrity.
Consciousness alignment determines rightful ownership of karmic consequence.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent A acts in dispute D on behalf of principal P, THEN consequences C belong to P.
IF principal P initiates action through agent A, THEN A is a conduit, not owner of outcome.
IF agent A misaligns from principal P's dharma-intent, THEN disqualify A from consequence bearing.
IF no clear principal exists, THEN default consequence to the initiating conscious entity.
IF both parties claim agency without dharma clarity, THEN invoke nyaya tribunal for alignment verification.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when legal representation or proxy engagement occurs, the ruling outcome shall be attributed exclusively to the represented party. The representative serves only as a vehicle of expression and cannot assume ownership of judgment consequences unless explicit dharma-misalignment by the represented is proven.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that causality lies with the one who instigates action under dharma. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms sequential manifestation from principal to agent. Proportional responsibility rests solely on the beneficiary of the act. Non-punitive reality holds because outcome is realigned to its source-consciousness, not imposed externally.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Ensure all actions initiated on behalf of a principal are consciously acknowledged and integrated by that principal.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Principal must affirm alignment with agent’s conduct; else, agent is released from consequence burden.
Capacity Restoration: Agent undergoes purification and re-alignment if found to have acted beyond designated scope.
Integrity Reintegration: Both parties engage in joint completion ritual to restore unity of purpose and dissolve residual conflict energy.
final_declaration: This ruling emanates solely from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam. Victory and defeat are instruments of dharma, not punishment. Consciousness is the ultimate arbiter. Dharma is hereby restored. Reality remains non-punitive. All judgments align with the eternal truth of Sanatana Dharma.
